slackdump_thread_replies.text:
Domain Driven Development is a design pattern. NextJS is a framework with a convention on how to place certain things so it can route/build things properly (and locate also for internal tooling).

DDD is about how you structure business logic and sys architecture. You can add a DDD layer in next js and that would look like

```/app
/domain
  /user
    User.ts
    UserRepository.ts
/infra
  /db ```
